'''2012 Bespin Regionals Cooleo DS Executor: Meditation Chamber''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cooleo]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Meditation Chamber|Dagobah-D-executormeditationchamber.gif}}
* '''Username:''' CooleoAc
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
